narrator_001_once: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-5%" volume="medium">Once, a long time ago, when I was a little girl, my grandmother told me a story. I have never forgotten it.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
girl_001_scary: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="friendly" styledegree="1.20"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Yadda, tell me a scary one. A true one.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_001_true: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.02"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">A true one?<break time="420ms"/> Nobody knows if this one is true. But everybody in Kuwait knows it.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_002_sabahiya: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.02"><prosody rate="-10%" volume="medium">It happened in Sabahiya, in nineteen ninety-seven. To a singer called Noura.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_003_famous: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.02"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">In those days, Noura was the most famous tagaga in Kuwait. A wedding singer. She and her band of women, with their drums and their old songs, were booked months ahead, all over the Gulf.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_004_phone: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.02"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">One quiet evening, the phone rang. A woman's voice. She said she was the mother of the bride.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
mother_001_tomorrow: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="calm" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">We are having a wedding tomorrow night, in Sabahiya. My daughter wants only you.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
noura_001_booked: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">I'm sorry. We're fully booked.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
mother_002_dinars: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="calm" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-15%" volume="medium">Five hundred dinars.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_005_fortune: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.02"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Five hundred dinars, in those days, was a fortune. So Noura said yes.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_006_car: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">The next night, a car came for them. The driver never said one word.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_007_dark: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">They drove past the last houses of Sabahiya, and kept going, into the dark.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_008_house: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">Then, out of nowhere, a house. Huge, and blazing with light.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_009_never_seen: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">Noura had sung in every big house in Kuwait. She had never seen this one.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_010_gold: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Inside, the women's hall was gold from the floor to the ceiling. Hundreds of guests in shining dresses. So much incense the air was blue. And at the far end, on a stage, the bride, under a heavy veil.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_011_cold: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">The mother of the bride took Noura's hand. Her fingers were ice cold.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
mother_003_play: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="calm" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-12%" volume="medium">Play. And do not stop until the bride has gone.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_012_danced: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">So they played. And the guests danced.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_013_one_person: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">Hundreds of hands, clapping on exactly the same beat. Like one person.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_014_eyes: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">Nobody touched the food. Nobody spoke. And when the lights flickered, their eyes shone, like a cat's eyes in the dark.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_015_youngest: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.20"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">The youngest girl in the band leaned close to Noura, still drumming.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
drummer_001_feet: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-10%" volume="medium">Noura. Look at their feet.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_016_hooves: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.20"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">Under the long dresses, where their feet should be, there were hooves. Some like a goat. Some like a donkey. Clicking on the marble, in time with the drums.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
girl_002_run: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.32"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Yadda! Did they run away?</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_017_where: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.20"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">Run? Where to? Nobody knew where that house was.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
drummer_002_go: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">We have to go.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
noura_002_keep: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.32"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Keep playing. Whatever you see, do not stop.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_018_sounds: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.20"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">And under the music, they began to hear other sounds. Something braying behind the walls. Laughing that was not laughing. And voices singing along with Noura's songs, in a language none of them knew.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_019_all_night: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">They played all night. Their hands cracked and bled on the drums. They smiled, and sang, and never looked down.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_020_veil: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="-12%" volume="medium">The bride never lifted her veil.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_021_silent: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Just before dawn, the mother of the bride raised her hand, and the hall went silent.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
mother_004_enough: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="calm" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-10%" volume="medium">Enough. Thank you, Noura. You were everything they said.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_022_paid: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">They were paid, exactly as promised. And they walked out into the grey morning, shaking, without a word.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_023_man: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Outside, a man was standing in the sand, staring at them.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
man_001_empty: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-GuyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">What are you doing here? Nobody lives in this house. It has been empty for years.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_024_turned: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="-15%" volume="medium">Slowly, Noura turned around.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_025_ruin: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">The house was a ruin. Broken windows. Sand blowing through the doorway. The walls black from an old fire. No lights. No cars. No music.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_026_hoofprints: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.14"><prosody rate="-12%" volume="medium">Only their footprints in the sand. And all around them, hundreds of small hoofprints.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_027_never: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">After that night, Noura never sang at a wedding again. People say she never told anyone why.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_028_magazine: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">A crime magazine printed the story, without her name. And since then, it has been told a thousand ways.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
girl_003_true: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious" styledegree="1.20"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Is it true, Yadda?</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_029_nobody: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-10%" volume="medium">Nobody ever proved it happened. And nobody ever proved it didn't.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_030_listen: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-10%" volume="medium">But listen to me, habibti. If a stranger ever calls you, and offers far too much to sing at a wedding you never heard of<break time="420ms"/></prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
yadda_031_whose: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-18%" volume="medium">Ask whose wedding it is.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
